name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
short_description: Centrally sponsored scholarship providing financial support to Scheduled Caste students studying in classes 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, and Postgraduate courses.
benefits: Compulsory non-refundable fees paid to the institution plus maintenance allowance of up to ₹13,500 per year directly to student bank account via DBT.
required_documents: College/School Fee Receipt and Admission Letter
how_to_apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) using your One-Time Registration (OTR) ID.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
short_description: Ministry of Tribal Affairs centrally sponsored scheme for Scheduled Tribe students pursuing recognized post-matriculation courses.
benefits: Full course fee reimbursement, study tour charges, and monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers and ₹550/month for day scholars.
required_documents: ST Caste Certificate issued by competent Revenue Authority
how_to_apply: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR and submit application under Ministry of Tribal Affairs.

name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT Students
short_description: Central scheme for Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-Notified Tribes (DNT) studying from class 11 to post-graduation.
benefits: Academic allowance and tuition fees assistance credited directly to bank account via DBT.
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment section.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
short_description: Supports parents of Scheduled Caste children studying in Class 9 and 10 to reduce school dropout rates.
benefits: Annual grant of ₹3,500 for day scholars and ₹7,000 for hostellers plus 10% disability allowance if applicable.
how_to_apply: Apply via school nodal officer or online via state portal / scholarships.gov.in.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
short_description: Ministry of Minority Affairs scheme for meritorious students belonging to notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi).
benefits: Admission and course fees up to ₹10,000/year plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority (<= ₹2 Lakhs)
how_to_apply: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: Merit Cum Means Scholarship for Professional & Technical Courses (Minorities)
short_description: Financial assistance for meritorious minority students pursuing graduate or post-graduate technical and professional degrees (Engineering, Medical, Law, etc.).
benefits: Course fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000 per annum plus maintenance allowance of ₹1,000/month for hostellers and ₹500/month for day scholars.
required_documents: Mark sheet of previous qualifying exam (minimum 50%)
Competitive exam rank card / admission allotment letter
Institution fee structure and payment receipts
how_to_apply: Apply online through scholarships.gov.in under Ministry of Minority Affairs.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
short_description: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities scheme for disabled students studying in classes 9 and 10.
benefits: Maintenance allowance of ₹700/month for day scholars and ₹1,000/month for hostellers, plus book grant of ₹1,000/year and disability allowances.
required_documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate issued by Competent Medical Authority (40% or more disability)
how_to_apply: Apply through scholarships.gov.in under Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
short_description: Financial assistance for students with 40% or more disability pursuing higher secondary, diploma, UG, PG, or PhD degrees.
benefits: Maintenance allowance up to ₹1,600/month, book grant of up to ₹1,500/year, and disability-specific allowances (reader allowance, escort allowance).
required_documents: UDID Card or Disability Certificate (40% and above)
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in under DEPwD section.

name: Top Class Education Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
short_description: Supports disabled students studying in recognized premier institutes of excellence (IITs, NITs, IIMs, Central Universities).
benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement (capped at ₹2 Lakhs per annum for private institutes, full for govt), living expenses of ₹3,000/month, and computer grant of ₹30,000.
required_documents: UDID / Medical Board Disability Certificate (40% or more)
Proof of admission in notified Premier Institute
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal under Top Class Education for PwD.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
short_description: Department of Higher Education scheme for top 80th percentile scorers in Class 12 pursuing regular full-time degree programs.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three undergraduate years, and ₹20,000 per annum at the postgraduate level.
required_documents: Class 12 Marksheet (Must be in top 20th percentile of respective State Board)
how_to_apply: Submit online form on scholarships.gov.in under Department of Higher Education.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
short_description: Scholarship awarded to meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in government/aided schools from class 9 to 12.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) credited directly to bank account via DBT.
required_documents: NMMSS Selection Examination Result / Merit Certificate
Class 7/8 Marksheet (minimum 55% for General/OBC, 50% for SC/ST)
School Enrollment Certificate (Govt / Local Body / Aided school)
how_to_apply: Selected students through state level NMMSS exam must register on scholarships.gov.in to disburse funds.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
short_description: AICTE scheme aimed at empowering girl students admitted to technical degree or diploma courses in AICTE-approved institutions.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fee payment, computer purchase, books, and equipment.
required_documents: Admission letter for AICTE approved Technical Degree/Diploma course
Parent declaration that family has maximum 2 girl beneficiaries
how_to_apply: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under AICTE schemes.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Differently Abled Students
short_description: AICTE financial incentive encouraging specially-abled students to pursue technical education (Degree/Diploma).
benefits: ₹50,000 per year towards tuition fees, purchase of laptop, software, assistive devices, and books.
required_documents: Disability Certificate showing minimum 40% benchmark disability
how_to_apply: Apply via National Scholarship Portal under AICTE scheme header.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
short_description: Tamil Nadu state government flagship initiative providing ₹1,000 per month to girl students who studied classes 6 to 12 in government schools and enroll in higher education.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 per year) transferred directly to the student's bank account until successful completion of UG degree, diploma, or ITI.
required_documents: School Transfer Certificate (TC) or Study Certificate proving Class 6 to 12 study in TN Government School
how_to_apply: Applied through college nodal officer on penkalvi.tn.gov.in / umis.tn.gov.in portal.
deadline: At the start of college academic year (usually July - September)

name: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme
short_description: Tamil Nadu state scheme granting ₹1,000 monthly assistance to boy students who studied classes 6 to 12 in government or government-aided Tamil medium schools pursuing higher education.
benefits: ₹1,000 monthly allowance credited to bank account via DBT for textbooks, study materials, and college living expenses.
required_documents: Proof of studying classes 6 to 12 in TN Govt / Aided School (Tamil medium)
Higher education admission letter / college ID
how_to_apply: Facilitated by college nodal officers using student EMIS records on the UMIS portal (umis.tn.gov.in).
deadline: At the start of college academic year (usually August - October)

name: Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Scholarship for BC / MBC / DNC Students
short_description: State scholarship scheme for students belonging to Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities studying in post-matric courses in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement and special maintenance allowance up to ₹7,500/year depending on day-scholar or hosteller status.
required_documents: Community Certificate (BC / MBC / DNC) from e-Sevai / Tahsildar
College Admission Bonafide and Fee Receipt
how_to_apply: Apply through the college scholarship office or TN e-Sevai / BC-MBC Welfare department portal.
